mechanism: The application of biomedical engineering to develop implant surface modifications that prevent thrombosis.
intervention: Apply a heparin-eluting polymer coating to the hip implant's femoral stem and acetabular cup to locally inhibit platelet aggregation and clot formation.
expected_effect: Reduced thrombus formation on the implant surface while preserving mechanical stability and joint function.
falsification_test: In a rabbit model, compare thrombus mass and implant function (via gait analysis) between coated and uncoated implants after 12 weeks; if no significant reduction in thrombosis or if implant loosening occurs, the mechanism is invalidated.
